Class ClientModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.ClientModel
public class ClientModel extends Object
Client-side model. Receives callbacks from RmiClient (via VirtualViewRmi) and notifies registered observers (e.g. CLIView, GUIView) using the Observer pattern. Has no knowledge of RMI or Socket internals.
